issues.issue: Did the screening tools abuse the employer's authority by treating PRRA officers as quasi-judicial decision makers and immigration officers as administrative?
issues.applicant_position: PRRA and immigration officers do essentially the same work, so the quasi-judicial distinction is unsupported and favours PRRA officers.
issues.respondent_position: PRRA officers have a statutory hearing mandate and the same legal test as RPD members; the employer may set qualifications.
issues.result_quote: The Board’s conclusions are supported by the evidence which it accepted.

issues.issue: Did the reference document and schedule fetter the screening committee's discretion?
issues.applicant_position: Lists of qualifying and non-qualifying positions excluded immigration officers a priori, so his experience was never assessed on its merits.
issues.respondent_position: Tools were guides only; committees used judgment, and the screener approached his file with an open mind.
issues.result_quote: The applicant has not shown any reason why it should not have done so.
